analysis: Successful trial: host validation macro HR@10 was 0.5737, exceeding the stated 0.505 reference by 0.0687. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.605, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.595, Electronics 0.435, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.660. Electronics remains the weakest category. Results support further investigation of recurrent sequence modeling, but do not isolate recurrence as the cause of improvement. Allocated GPU time was 248.19 seconds. No test results were available.
code_summary: Trained one independent network per category from scratch: 96-dimensional item embeddings, input LayerNorm, dropout 0.25, a two-layer GRU, and a linear projection with LayerNorm. Normalized hidden states score normalized tied item embeddings using a jointly learned scale and item bias. Training uses dense next-item supervision, eight uniform negatives per position, softplus loss, AdamW, mixed precision, and gradient clipping. Histories are capped at 128 items with occasional earlier training windows. Validation HR@10 selects one checkpoint per category, with NDCG as a tie-breaker and 25-epoch patience. The generated predictor routes by dataset and loads exactly one checkpoint per category; no ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is used.
